evaluation-policy: An internal BraTS split is not an independent external test and cannot support an external-generalization claim.
planner-policy: The planner is read-only. It may propose one pre-approved matrix job, but it cannot execute training or modify a run.
protocol-contract: The adult-glioma research protocol requires exactly T1, T1ce, T2, and FLAIR MRI sequences.
provenance-policy: Raw source files are stored once and manifests reference them. Raw medical data must not be silently duplicated or overwritten.
safety-policy: The language layer is research output only. It may not diagnose, recommend treatment, give patient-specific advice, select a medical model, or inspect raw images.
